Package Fitness.InstructorP.Communicate

Class MessagingSystem

java.lang.Object
Fitness.InstructorP.Communicate.MessagingSystem
public class MessagingSystem extends Object
The MessagingSystem class facilitates communication between an Instructor and a Client. It manages the message lists for both the instructor and the client, and allows adding or removing messages. The system handles a list of all messages as well as separate message lists for the instructor and client.

This class provides methods to:

  • Add and remove messages to/from the system
  • Manage messages specific to the instructor and client
Example usage: 
 Instructor instructor = new Instructor(...);
 Client client = new Client(...);
 MessagingSystem messagingSystem = new MessagingSystem(instructor, client);
 Message message = new Message(...);
 messagingSystem.addMessage(message);
Author:
Omar Abumazen
